scope: read-only retrospective traces; stationary does not establish planner failure

method.paired_rows: action at row t compared with proprio at row t+1; final action has no next observation and is excluded
method.tracking_error: Euclidean distance from action[t] position to proprio[t+1] position
method.contacts: Any nonempty gripper contact list; includes arbitrary bodies, not proof of task-object grasp
method.limitation: Thresholds are retrospective descriptive diagnostics, not preregistered outcome tests or direct planner telemetry.
